verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments and financial platform, since self-hostable payment and billing stacks exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Airwallex offering a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of its core product. Every documented component (payments, the AgentOS MCP server at mcp.airwallex.com, the hosted payment page, the sandbox) is a vendor-hosted service, and the CLI and MCP connectors are only clients of that service.
